service.description: The operation queues of the user's selected facility that their capabilities reach, each with its ready, waiting, late and backorder counts (null where the queue is not counted; counts since P10), and the work assigned to them (the open counts whose assignee they are; picks and inspections come with their phases). Refuses a user without Warehouse and a facility outside the scope.

parameter.name: queueRows
parameter.description: Each queue's operation, title, readyCount, waitingCount, lateCount and backorderCount.

set.from: [['receiving', 'Receiving', true], ['putaway', 'Putaway', can.move], ['inspection', 'Inspection', can.inspect || can.qualityVerify || can.qualityDispose], ['picking', 'Picking', can.pick || can.loadEdit], ['packing', 'Packing', can.pack], ['shipping', 'Shipping', true], ['returns', 'Returns', true], ['transfers', 'Transfers', true], ['counts', 'Counts', can.count || can.countReview || can.adjust]]
queues.filter(queue => queue[2]).map(queue => ({operation: queue[0], title: queue[1], readyCount: null, waitingCount: null, lateCount: null, backorderCount: null}))
queueRows.map(row => row.operation === 'counts' && countWork?.queue ? Object.assign({}, row, countWork.queue) : row)

service.description: The Warehouse today-source (Warehouse.xml shell-providers; get#UserTodayItems calls it): the work assigned to the user in their facilities (Today.js), now the open counts whose assignee they are (F42). P10 built it; P8 adds the inspections whose inspector the user is and P11 the loads still open from an earlier day, each a source of Today.js. A user without Warehouse gets none.
